clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope

clauses.title: This standard covers the
clauses.text: 1.1 This standard covers the requirements, such as materials, workmanship, finish, strength tests, general design provisions, tolerances on dimensions and marking for slotted sections.

clauses.title: This standard does not
clauses.text: 1.2 This standard does not apply to steel sections used for the fabrication of metal shelving cabinet (adjustable type) and metal shelving racks (adjustable type).

clauses.title: Materials – Steel and
clauses.text: 2. Materials -  Steel and Aluminium shall conform to specified grades.

clauses.title: Workmanship – Sections shall
clauses.text: 3. Workmanship - Sections shall be supplied free from all burrs.

clauses.title: Finishes
clauses.text: 4. Finishes  -  Before any paint finish is applied, all surfaces shall be free from scale, grease, rust or other surface imperfections. A coat of anti-rust treatment shall be applied before painting the steel surfaces.

clauses.title: Galvanizing or anodizing, if
clauses.text: 4.1 Galvanizing or anodizing, if required, shall comply with prescribed standards.

clauses.title: Strength – Failure loads
clauses.text: 5. Strength -  Failure loads determined as in 6.1.3 of the standard shall be reduced in the following ratio :

clauses.title: Minimum yield stress of material (min
clauses.text: 5.1 Minimum yield stress of material (min. 0.2 percent proof stress in case of aluminium sections)

clauses.title: Yield stress of test piece
clauses.text: 5.2 Yield stress of test piece  (0.2 percent  proof stress in case of aluminium sections)

clauses.title: In no case shall
clauses.text: 5.3 In no case shall this ratio be greater than one. Note — For the purpose of this standard the minimum yield stress of malerial (other than aluminium sections) shall be taken as given in Table 2 of the stand ard.

clauses.title: General Design Provisions
clauses.text: 6. General Design Provisions

clauses.title: Permissible loads and factors of safety
clauses.text: 6.1 Permissible loads and factors of safety  —  Safe working loads shall be obtained by dividing failure load value by minimum factor of safety specified in the standard.

clauses.title: Limiting Beam Deflection –
clauses.text: 6.2 Limiting Beam Deflection -  Should not exceed 1/ 180 of the span. SUMMARY OF IS 8081 : 1976 SLOTTED SECTIONS For detailed information, refer to IS 8081 : 1976 Specifications for slotted sections

clauses.title: Tolerance of Dimensions –
clauses.text: 7. Tolerance of Dimensions -

clauses.title: Flange Sectional Dimensions –
clauses.text: 7.1 Flange Sectional Dimensions - The tolerance on sum of the dimensions of all flanges shall not exceed the following: Nominal Size Tolerance Over Up to and Percent Including mm mm - 40 ± 5 40 50 ± 4 50 75 ± 3 75 - ± 2

clauses.title: Flange Thickness – The
clauses.text: 7.2 Flange Thickness - The tolerances on the thickness of the section, for steel and for aluminium section shall conform to the respective specification as appropriate.

clauses.title: Internal Radius of Bend
clauses.text: 7.3 Internal Radius of Bend - The internal radius of bend shall have a tolerance of 1.00 mm on the nominal radius.

clauses.title: Angle of Bend
clauses.text: 7.4 Angle of Bend  - The angle of bend shall be ± 20 throughout the width of the flange.

clauses.title: Size of Holes –The
clauses.text: 7.5 Size of Holes -The tolerance on size of holes shall be  ± 0.1 mm.

clauses.title: Pitch of Holes –
clauses.text: 7.6 Pitch of Holes - The deviation in the pitch of holes shall be  ± 0.1 mm.

clauses.title: Overall Length
clauses.text: 7.7 Overall Length

clauses.title: Standard Length – The
clauses.text: 7.7.1 Standard Length - The tolerance on standard lengths shall be ± 1.6 mm.

clauses.title: Overall Centre
clauses.text: 7.7.2 Overall Centre-to-Centre of End Holes - The tolerance on overall centre-to-centre of end holes shall be ± 1.6 mm.

clauses.title: Straightness
clauses.text: 7.8 Straightness — The offset shall not be more than 1/600 of the length.

clauses.title: Twist of Section
clauses.text: 7.9 Twist of Section — The twist of section shall not be more than 40 minutes of angle per metre.
